Hymn 305: The Light Divine
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major

This is hymn number 305 titled "The Light Divine" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Matilda W. Cahoon and the lyrics were written by Matilda W. Cahoon.
